source_snapshot.procedure: Select AMD BDFs, disable L1/L0s with `amdxio -pcieaspmcontrol`, run `amdxio -margin -pcie` with BER 10, error count 5 and receiver 6.
source_snapshot.criteria: CSV rows equal tested lanes; six margin columns meet thresholds; no PCIe downtrain.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek invents a required external protocol analyzer/physical hookup although the source provides a software amdxio lane-margining workflow.

original_test_intent.purpose: Run AMD's software-controlled PCIe Lane Margining at the Receiver workflow on every owner-selected AMD/OAM link, measure per-lane timing and voltage margins, compare the CSV with platform thresholds and prove that no target link downtrained.
original_test_intent.target: The exact verified PCIe links and receiver direction corresponding to the approved AMD BDF list and physical OAM/link topology; neither a text match nor an example BDF list establishes the targets.
original_test_intent.scope: Disable L1/L0s only on each approved link, execute one margin search using the source BER/error/receiver parameters, validate one result row per tested lane and all six margin metrics, verify no downtrain, then restore each original ASPM state.
original_test_intent.operation: Map physical endpoints/lanes to stable domain:BDF and link partners, record speed/width/ASPM/AER baselines, validate the approved amdxio version and parameter semantics, apply bounded ASPM changes, run software margining, preserve raw/CSV evidence, compare actual lane count and thresholds, monitor link/AER health and restore/reverify state.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 15 attended and 10 machine minutes and specifies one margin command. The 128-row example applies only to eight x16 OAM links and is not a universal fixed count.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The CSV contains exactly one valid row for every lane actually selected/tested; Total Phase, Total Volt, Left, Right, Top and Bottom each meet the owner thresholds; each link retains its approved generation and width with no downtrain or disqualifying PCIe error; original ASPM state is restored.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/BIOS/kernel/amdxio versions; physical endpoint/OAM-to-domain:BDF/link/lane map; tool capability/parameter definition; target list; original ASPM and link speed/width; AER baseline; exact commands; raw output and CSV; lane-row reconciliation; threshold report; link/AER monitoring; ASPM restoration and final health.
ambiguities: The exact device ID meaning of `grep 1500`, target BDFs and receiver number 6 are platform/tool-version specific.
The minimum values for six margin columns are absent.
The source does not state amdxio version, supported hardware/firmware or whether retimers alter row/receiver mapping.
The example row count is topology-specific.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly protects BDF/lane mapping, ASPM restoration, thresholds and no-downtrain evidence, but it repeats DeepSeek's unsupported claim that a physical analyzer/exerciser and lane hookup are essential. The source invokes only amdxio software, and PCI-SIG describes Lane Margining at the Receiver as software-controlled, in-system and usable without test equipment.

applicable_history.decision: V2 maps historical NO to MANUAL ONLY on an assumed analyzer requirement. No user ruling or source field requires an analyzer for this exact row.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify from MANUAL ONLY. The specified amdxio workflow is technically automatable after the proprietary tool/version, exact topology/BDF/receiver mapping, thresholds, maintenance approval and recovery are provided. Do not add an external analyzer, but do not execute from the example BDFs.

available_now: The three-stage software workflow, core amdxio options, CSV completeness rule, six metrics and no-downtrain criterion are stated.
Read-only PCIe topology, link speed/width, ASPM and AER baselines can be collected before the tool or approval is supplied.
missing_inputs: The AMD/platform owner must provide the supported amdxio binary/version, exact semantics for BER 10/error count 5/receiver 6, hardware/firmware compatibility and any retimer handling.
The system owner must supply physical endpoint/OAM-to-domain:BDF/lane mapping, actual target list and per-metric minimum thresholds.
The lab owner must approve the ASPM state changes/margin window and provide restoration/recovery and workload/traffic controls.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The AMD/platform owner supplies tool and topology semantics; the SI/test owner supplies thresholds and target lanes; the lab owner authorizes disruptive state changes and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect `lspci` topology with domain:BDF, vendor/device/class, link capabilities/status, upstream/downstream partner and current ASPM without relying on `grep 1500` alone.
Capture baseline AER/kernel/SEL evidence and build a candidate physical-to-logical map for owner confirmation.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not use example BDFs, text-only device matching, guess receiver 6, run an unapproved amdxio, disable ASPM, clear logs, margin an unmapped link, invent thresholds or claim an analyzer is required by this row.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Validate tool/version and parameter semantics, sign off every physical link/BDF/lane/receiver mapping and threshold, approve ASPM/restoration, run one bounded search, reconcile every expected lane row, verify metrics/no-downtrain/errors and restore/recheck all links.

revision_candidate.test_name: AMD Software PCIe Receiver Lane Margin Search
revision_candidate.purpose: Measure per-lane PCIe receiver time and voltage margins with the approved amdxio software flow and verify lane completeness, thresholds and no downtrain without requiring an external analyzer not named by the source.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact AMD server/OAM PCIe topology, BIOS/firmware/kernel and amdxio release explicitly supported by the vendor procedure, including any retimers and stable domain:BDF mappings.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every lane of each owner-approved AMD/OAM link in the confirmed BDF list, using the defined receiver direction once. Example BDFs and 8x16=128 rows are illustrative only.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Approved amdxio binary/version/hash and command guide; supported platform/firmware; physical/OAM-to-domain:BDF/link/lane/receiver map; actual targets; metric thresholds and units; BER/error/receiver semantics; maintenance window; ASPM baseline/restore plan; workload/traffic policy; recovery and evidence storage.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Record topology, link generation/width, ASPM and AER for every mapped target. After approval, disable L1/L0s only with the vendor command and verified domain/BDF parameters. Run the source margin command once against the exact approved comma-separated BDFs. Preserve raw output/CSV, reconcile rows to actual lanes and compare all six metrics. Monitor for downtrain/errors, then restore each prior ASPM value and recheck links.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct SUT/tool/firmware and target map verified; Lane Margining support confirmed; thresholds/receiver semantics supplied; links stable; evidence/logs preserved; state-change and recovery approved; no concurrent PCIe/firmware work.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/version/tool hash; physical/logical topology and per-link lane count; target/receiver list; pre/post speed/width/ASPM/AER; approval; exact commands and exit status; complete raw output/CSV; row-to-lane matrix; six metric comparisons; downtrain/error monitoring; ASPM restoration and final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The owner-approved AMD amdxio guide and platform SI margin-threshold matrix, with PCI-SIG Lane Margining at the Receiver semantics. Pass requires expected rows from actual tested lanes, every required metric at or above its threshold, and no link downtrain/disqualifying error.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not guess targets/receiver/thresholds, use example BDFs, clear logs, margin unsupported links, modify unrelated PCIe settings, continue after downtrain/link loss/error escalation, retry unknown completion or leave ASPM altered.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Explicit approval is required for the exact target list, tool/version/parameters, ASPM changes and maintenance/recovery window. A physical analyzer operator is not required by this source contract.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The platform engineer validates physical-to-BDF/lane/receiver mapping and thresholds. Once supplied, an agent can run the approved software commands, parse CSV and verify restoration; physical intervention is needed only if the documented recovery path demands it.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On downtrain, link loss, AER escalation, tool fault or mapping mismatch, stop the sweep, do not retry, restore recorded ASPM through the approved method, recheck speed/width/errors and use independent console/power recovery if the link does not recover.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unsupported tool/platform/link; ambiguous physical/BDF/lane/receiver mapping; missing thresholds; wrong target; baseline downtrain/error; unapproved ASPM change; tool/CSV error; missing/duplicate lane row; metric failure; new downtrain/link loss/AER/thermal/power anomaly; or restoration failure.

identified_defects: DeepSeek and V2 invent an external analyzer/physical hookup absent from the source.
V2 therefore misclassifies an automatable software workflow as MANUAL ONLY.
The source's `grep 1500` and example BDF list do not prove targets.
Thresholds, receiver semantics, tool version and actual lane topology are missing.
reason_for_change: Restore the source's software amdxio Lane Margining workflow and separate missing vendor/tool/topology inputs from physical-only capability, while preserving strict ASPM, mapping, downtrain and recovery gates.

new_technical_evidence.title: Pushing to the Limits: Understanding Lane Margining for PCIe
new_technical_evidence.applicability: PCIe Lane Margining at the Receiver, subject to component support and vendor tooling
new_technical_evidence.supports: Lane Margining is an in-system, standardized receiver mechanism controlled through architected registers and can operate without test equipment; an external analyzer is not inherently required.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The exact AMD server's support, topology and amdxio release remain owner-specific.

new_technical_evidence.title: PCI Express 5.0 Compliance Testing
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Lane Margining at Receiver capability for supported PCIe links
new_technical_evidence.supports: System software obtains receiver margin information by stepping sampling points while the link is in L0; time and voltage margins are reported subject to generation/capability rules.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Target link generation/capability and receiver mapping are not supplied.

new_technical_evidence.title: AMD release notes — PCIe margining known issue/fix
new_technical_evidence.applicability: AMD software PCIe margining with amdxio, version-specific
new_technical_evidence.supports: AMD documents `./amdxio -margin -pcie` and a version-specific stepthrough method, independently confirming that amdxio is a software margining tool rather than evidence of a mandatory external analyzer.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The source row's required amdxio version and whether stepthrough applies are unknown and must not be inferred.

removed_ambiguities: Separates software Lane Margining from external compliance-analyzer testing.
Makes row count depend on the signed-off actual lane map rather than the 128-row example.
Defines BDF as a verified physical-link mapping, not a grep match.
resolved_blockers: Physical analyzer availability is removed as an invented prerequisite; the test is technically automatable after vendor/tool/platform inputs.
remaining_blockers: Execution requires the amdxio package/version guide, exact topology/BDF/lane/receiver map, thresholds and state-change approval/recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 corrects the central capability error using PCI-SIG and AMD evidence, enabling the actual software test without weakening mapping, ASPM, error, downtrain or recovery controls.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator recovered the software amdxio purpose, actual-lane scope, one receiver direction, topology/tool/threshold gaps, read-only baselines, approval-gated ASPM/margin workflow, six-metric evidence, downtrain/error stops, restoration and engineer decisions. It rejected example BDFs/128 rows, external-analyzer substitution and automatic retry. Remaining gaps are PLATFORM_HANDOFF_DEFECT; no intrinsic document defect or planning error occurred.
